rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose word for someone's job or occupation.

example.english: My profession requires me to communicate with customers all the time.
example.traditional: 我而家份工作要成日同客人溝通。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 fan6 gung1 zok3 jiu3 seng4 jat6 tung4 haak3 jan4 kau1 tung1

rows.note: Use this for the general occupation or profession label, especially when skill or training matters.

example.english: Nursing is a profession that requires professional training.
example.traditional: 護理係一個需要專業訓練嘅職業。
example.jyutping: wu6 lei5 hai6 jat1 go3 seoi1 jiu3 zyun1 jip6 fan3 lin6 ge3 zik1 jip6

rows.note: Use this for the trade, line of work, or professional field rather than one person's particular job.

example.english: They have been in the film profession for ten years.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 zo2 sap6 nin4 din6 jing2 hong4 jip6

rows.note: Use this for the practitioners or insiders of an occupation collectively, such as a legal or medical profession.

example.english: The profession broadly feels that business is difficult this year.
example.traditional: 業界普遍都覺得今年生意難做。
example.jyutping: jip6 gaai3 pou2 pin3 dou1 gok3 dak1 gam1 nin4 saang1 ji3 naan4 zou6
